rootCause.details: The same WebGL2 canvas and illuminatedIndices set are shared by the overview and cupmark observation stages. drawSelectedBeacon(), drawMarkers(), and pickMarker() only checked markersOn, not chapter-03 data-observation-mode. Lights/markers thus remained visible in the overview.

fix.artifactOverview: Draw the original stone model only, suppress cupmark beams, halos, marker dots, and marker picking
fix.cupmarkObservation: Restore previously illuminated cupmarks when entering observation again
fix.persistence: Do not clear illuminatedIndices, markersOn, lightActivationTimes, brightness or pulse/steady mode while changing stage
fix.performance: Cancel pending pulse-timer callbacks on exit from observation and avoid new pulse frames outside observation
fix.untouchedData: Original measured 46-cupmark data and scanned geometry preserved

regressionTests.environment: Headless Chromium + actual HTML/CSS/Viewer JS/main.js + real 46 measured cupmarks, mocked WebGL2 and tiny synthetic GLB
verifiedInteractions: Enter cupmark observation and activate C01
Return to artifact overview: model draws, light/markers do not
No hidden pulse rendering while idle
Re-enter cupmark observation: C01 beam and markers reappear
Turn on all 46 and verify restoration
notVerified: Actual GPU rasterization of the 700K GLB / atlas (WebGL2 context unavailable in headless Chromium in this environment)
Physical mobile hardware input and deployed GitHub Pages
